title: This Volcano Has Erupted Nonstop for 2,000 Years

scenes.text: This volcano has been erupting nonstop for about 2,000 years.
It's Stromboli, a small island volcano off Italy.
Every 10 to 30 minutes or so, it explodes.
Glowing lava fragments shoot 100 to 200 metres into the air.
Sailors used it as a beacon at night, so it earned the nickname Lighthouse of the Mediterranean.
A lighthouse that has been shooting fire for 2,000 years.

description:
Stromboli, a small volcano off Italy, has been erupting almost nonstop for about 2,000 years.
It explodes every 10 to 30 minutes or so and throws glowing lava up to 200 metres, so it is called the Lighthouse of the Mediterranean.
Would you climb it?
first_comment: Erupting for 2,000 years. Would you climb it at night?
